name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(at_goal) with the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) chain forces has_key before the goal, so the key pickup is required without a separate Existence(has_key). The order matches the task's 'then', and both clauses are hard as the task requires.

texts: Reach the goal (at_goal must happen at least once)
Pick up the key before reaching the goal (the goal must not be reached before the agent has the key)
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
